title: Chuyên đề thực tế-Quản lý Tài nguyên và Môi trường
duration: 15 hours of theory, 45 hours of practice

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply knowledge of economic and environmental resource management activities and management tools in domestic and international contexts.

Develop skills in synthesizing, analyzing, and systematic thinking; ability to organize and manage human resources for professional management activities in the field of environmental resource management.
Identify and analyze problems in environmental resource management, and develop solutions based on professional knowledge.
Work independently and collaboratively to solve assigned tasks.
Ability to search for materials, analyze, synthesize, and generalize issues in environmental resource management.
Ability to propose, argue, and defend viewpoints, and have a spirit of cooperation and responsibility towards work.
Ability to self-study and accumulate experience to improve professional expertise and adapt to changes in environmental resource management.
Write comprehensive reports on environmental resource management topics.
Manage and coordinate projects, and develop collective intelligence.
